ValidationRule.description: If the Disqualified Reason is Country then make Country field required.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Lead_Disqualified_Reason__c, "Country"), ISBLANK(Country), NOT ($UserRole.Name = "Admin") ) && Lead_Val_Bypass__c = False
ValidationRule.errorMessage: If you are disqualifying based on Country you must enter the Country in the Address Field.
